name: horizon-two-stage-relevance-benchmark
description: Permanent evaluation benchmark for the Horizon two-stage intelligence filtering pipeline across 5 research domains.

relevant_findings.title: LangGraph v0.2 Release: Durable Execution, Resumable Human-in-the-Loop, and Distributed Worker State
relevant_findings.excerpt: LangGraph v0.2 introduces native state persistence with checkpointing backends, enabling workflows to pause, resume, and fork across independent worker processes. Includes built-in multi-agent tool governance and transactional memory.
relevant_findings.notes: Core agent infrastructure with durable execution and multi-agent coordination.

relevant_findings.title: Megatron-LM Core 0.8: Optimized 3D Parallelism with Pipeline Bubble Reduction and FP8 Kernel Fusion
relevant_findings.excerpt: NVIDIA Megatron-LM v0.8 adds interleaved 1F1B scheduling for pipeline parallelism, reducing idle execution bubbles by 42% on H100 GPU clusters. Features fused CUDA kernels for FP8 attention layers.
relevant_findings.notes: High-signal distributed training infrastructure advance with quantified throughput improvements.

relevant_findings.title: Hybrid Search at Scale: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Combining BM25 Lexical Inverted Indexes and HNSW Embeddings
relevant_findings.excerpt: This paper presents a scalable reciprocal rank fusion architecture that reconciles exact-match keyword retrieval with semantic vector search in low-latency production indexing, demonstrating a 19% recall boost on technical documentation benchmarks.
relevant_findings.notes: Direct technical advance in hybrid retrieval and vector grounding.

relevant_findings.title: WCAG 2.2 Cognitive Accessibility Automated Audit: Measuring Working Memory Load in AI Interaction Flows
relevant_findings.excerpt: A standardized framework for testing cognitive accessibility and cognitive load in interactive AI assistant dialogues, integrating WCAG Success Criterion 3.3.7 (Redundant Entry) and automated user-testing heuristics.
relevant_findings.notes: Directly in-scope cognitive accessibility and AI-assisted usability testing framework.

relevant_findings.title: European Union Enacts Critical Raw Materials Bilateral Accord with Global Partners to Mitigate Supply Shock Risks
relevant_findings.excerpt: The European Commission finalized strategic bilateral trade accords securing lithium, cobalt, and rare earths supply chains, establishing joint stockpiling mechanisms and export quota guarantees through 2035.
relevant_findings.notes: Geopolitical economic security, trade policy, and supply-chain dependency.

borderline_findings.title: Apache Airflow 3.1: Task Execution Engine Enhancements and Dynamic Task Mapping Updates
borderline_findings.excerpt: Apache Airflow 3.1 improves batch pipeline scheduling, task-level retry policies, and Postgres metadata performance for standard data engineering workflows.
borderline_findings.notes: Data orchestration pipeline, but lacks agentic decision loop or tool autonomy.

borderline_findings.title: Single-Node PyTorch DataLoader Multi-threading Benchmark on High-Performance NVMe Storage
borderline_findings.excerpt: Benchmarking Python worker concurrency and memory mapping bottlenecks for image datasets residing on local PCIe Gen5 solid-state drives.
borderline_findings.notes: Performance optimization for training, but confined to single-node data loading.

borderline_findings.title: sqlite-vec: An Exploration of Local SQLite Extensions for Vector Similarity Scoring
borderline_findings.excerpt: A short walkthrough on building an embedded desktop notes search app using SQLite C extensions for cosine similarity.
borderline_findings.notes: Desktop tutorial without distributed scaling or formal grounding evaluation.

borderline_findings.title: Redesigning SaaS Application Dropdown Menus for Improved Desktop Visual Polish
borderline_findings.excerpt: Visual design considerations for modern Figma UI components, spacing variables, and border-radius aesthetics.
borderline_findings.notes: Generic UI visual design; lacks assistive, cognitive, or accessibility testing evaluation.
